svg.aria-label: Mohammad Yehya — system design, AI, developer tooling. I have a mild obsession with System Design and AI. If there's a new tech out there, I'm probably already trying to break it or make it better. Alongside, an impossible ring — a Möbius loop of eleven segments, continuously morphing.
